title: The Goal the Whole Team Scored
coreQuestion: How did Carlos Alberto's 1970 final goal come from a team-wide move?

facts.claim: Brazil played Italy in the 1970 World Cup final at the Estadio Azteca in Mexico City.
Carlos Alberto scored Brazil's fourth goal.
Pelé passed the ball to Carlos Alberto for the goal.
The goal is considered one of the greatest team goals.

narration.text: One goal, built by almost the whole team.
The 1970 World Cup final. Brazil against Italy, at the Azteca.
The ball moved from player to player across the pitch.
Carlos Alberto arrived and struck it in, Brazil's fourth goal. Every goal has a story.
